name: Other Spreadsheets
body:
Monster data borrowed from here, thanks to Mike Chopswil.

Pathfinder Bestiary with Statistics – Statistics page provides averages for Armor, Combat Maneuver values, Saves and more. Bestiary page sorted by CR.
Pathfinder Animals – Animals list sorted by size for use with Wild Shape plus magical beasts at end of list for Beast Shape. Columns that are relevant to Beast Shape are moved up to the beginning.
Pathfinder Plant Creatures – Plant creatures sorted by size for Wild Shape and Plant Shape. Columns resorted by relevancy.
Pathfinder Weapons – Crude weapons comparison.

The above spreadsheets may not be pretty, but should still be helpful.
